extracted.intended_audience: IP law firm managers, patent attorneys, legal industry analysts/researchers, and policymakers
extracted.subtask_description: Extraction of survey metrics and reporting fields from the AIPLA 2023 Economic Survey relating to firm composition, hiring, staffing, outsourcing, summer associates, and billings for IP practices. Each metric is presented by role, ethnicity, firm size, location, and includes summary statistics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of IP Partner-track attorneys by ethnicity in the firm in 2022 (Q10J)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of partner-track attorneys in 2022 broken down by ethnicity (White/Caucasian; Black/African American; Hispanic/Latino; Asian/Pacific Islander; N. American Indian/Native Canadian; Mixed Race; Other; TOTAL) and by firm size (One, Two, 3-5, 6-10, 11-30, 31-100, 101 or More).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summary statistics provided (Mean/Average, 1st Quartile 25%, Median, 3rd Quartile 75%) and Number of Firms Reporting shown for each cell.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of IP Non-partner track attorneys by ethnicity in the firm in 2022 (Q10K)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of non-partner-track attorneys in 2022 by the same ethnicity categories and firm-size buckets as Q10J.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes Mean/Average, quartiles (25%, median, 75%) and Number of Firms Reporting for each firm-size/ethnicity cell.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of IP Of Counsel (or equivalent) by ethnicity in the firm in 2022 (Q10L)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of Of Counsel (or equivalent) in 2022 broken down by ethnicity categories and firm-size buckets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes Mean/Average, quartiles, and Number of Firms Reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of IP Contract/Part-time professionals by ethnicity in the firm in 2022 (Q10M)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of contract or part-time IP professionals in 2022 by ethnicity and firm size.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes statistical summaries (mean, quartiles) and firms reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of USPTO-registered Patent Agents (not attorneys) by ethnicity in the firm in 2022 (Q10N)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of USPTO-registered patent agents (not attorneys) in 2022 by ethnicity and firm-size categories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes Mean/Average, quartiles and Number of Firms Reporting; some table cells may be marked ISD (insufficient data).

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of IP Technical Advisors/Assistants, including Searchers by ethnicity in the firm in 2022 (Q10O)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of technical advisors/assistants (including searchers) in 2022 by ethnicity and firm size.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes statistical summaries (mean, quartiles) and Number of Firms Reporting; multiple firm-size buckets presented.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of IP Paralegal/Legal Assistants (billable support staff) by ethnicity in the firm in 2022 (Q10P)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of paralegals/legal assistants (billable support) in 2022 broken down by ethnicity and firm-size categories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes mean, quartiles, and Number of Firms Reporting across firm-size buckets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Outsourced services in 2022 (Q11)
rubrics_metrics.description: Which services were outsourced in 2022: Docketing; Paralegal Support; IDSs; Searching; Prosecution Services; Litigation Services; International filing; Annuity payments. For each service, percentage outsourced in the US, outsourced abroad, outsourced in the US and abroad, and not outsourced are reported.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table shows Percent and Total Number of Firms Reporting for each service. Also includes a sub-table 'Services Not Outsourced in 2022, AI Tools Used by Firm' listing Number of Firms Outsourcing and Using AI Tools for each service.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of professionals who became associated with the firm in 2022 by role (Q12)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts in 2022 of professionals whose practice is primarily IP law who became associated with the firm, broken down by role: Equity Partner/Shareholder; Partner-track attorney; Non-partner track attorney; Of Counsel; Contract/Part-time; USPTO-registered Patent Agents; Technical Advisors/Assistants; Paralegal/Legal Assistants; Total IP Professionals. Presented by firm size.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes Number of Firms Reporting and summary statistics (mean, quartiles) for each role and firm-size bucket.

rubrics_metrics.name: Percentage of attorneys hired through a recruiter (head hunter) in 2022 (Q13)
rubrics_metrics.description: Percentage of attorneys hired through a recruiter (head hunter) in 2022, reported by firm size and ranges (<25%, 25%-50%, 50%-75%, 75%+ as presented).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table reports percentages of firms falling into each hiring-range category and Number of Firms Reporting; also provides third quartile (75%) value.

rubrics_metrics.name: Average fee paid to recruiter as a % of salary by size of firm (Q14)
rubrics_metrics.description: Average fee paid to recruiter as a percent of salary, reported by firm size (mean/average) and summary statistics (first quartile, median, third quartile).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Number of Firms Reporting shown; stats include mean, median, 25th and 75th percentiles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of professionals who left the firm in 2022 by role (Q15)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts in 2022 of IP professionals who left the firm, broken down by role (Equity Partner/Shareholder; Partner-track; Non-partner track; Of Counsel; Contract/Part-time; USPTO-registered Patent Agents; Technical Advisors/Assistants; Paralegal/Legal Assistants; Total IP Professionals) and by firm size.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes Number of Firms Reporting and summary statistics (mean, quartiles) per role and size.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of associates promoted in 2022 (Q16)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of associates promoted in 2022 to Non-equity partner and Equity partner, reported by firm size (11-30, 31-100, 101 or More) and All Firms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes Number of Firms Reporting and summary statistics (mean, first quartile, median, third quartile).

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribution of non-billable support staff devoted primarily to IP by size of firm in 2022 (Q17)
rubrics_metrics.description: Distribution (percent) of number-of-non-billable-support-staff categories devoted primarily to IP practice by firm size (categories include One, Two, 3-5, 6-10, 11-30, 31-100, 101 or More; and 21 or More). Also reports number of non-billable support staff in the firm (mean, median, quartiles) and non-billable support staff per IP attorney (mean, median, quartiles).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides percent of firms in each staff-size bucket, Number of Firms Reporting, and summary statistics for counts and ratios.

rubrics_metrics.name: Firm plans to hire more summer associates in 2023 than in 2022 (Q18)
rubrics_metrics.description: Binary Yes/No percent responses to whether the firm plans to hire more summer associates in 2023 than in 2022, reported by firm size, number of major office locations, percent of practice that is IP, and various metropolitan areas/locations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table provides percent Yes and No and Number of Firms Reporting for each subgroup.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of summer associates devoted primarily to IP practice, offers, acceptances (Q19A-C)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of summer associates devoted to IP in 2021 and 2022, number who received full-time offers, and number who accepted offers, reported by firm size (All Firms, and size buckets).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes Number of Firms Reporting and summary statistics (mean, quartiles) for counts in each year and stage (hired/offered/accepted).

rubrics_metrics.name: Monthly pay for summer associates devoted primarily to IP in 2022 (Q20)
rubrics_metrics.description: Monthly pay statistics for summer associates in 2022, reported by firm size with Mean/Average, Median, First Quartile (25%), Third Quartile (75%) and Number of Firms Reporting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quartiles and mean are provided for each firm-size bucket; amounts shown in dollars.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of summer associates expected in 2023 and 2024 (Q21)
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of summer associates expected in 2023 and 2024 by firm size (mean, median, quartiles) plus counts of firms 'Not Sure' for 2023 and 2024.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes Number of Firms Reporting and 'Not Sure' counts by firm size.

rubrics_metrics.name: Percent of firm's practice by billings that is IP and percent of billable IP hours actually billed (Q22-Q23)
rubrics_metrics.description: What percent of the firm's practice by billings is IP in 2022? And approximately what percent of the firm's billable IP hours in 2022 were actually billed to clients? Reported by firm-size buckets with Number of Firms Reporting and statistical summaries (mean, quartiles, median).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Both percent-of-practice and utilization (percent billed) are tabulated with mean/median/quartiles for subgroups.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allocation of firm's IP billings by type of work (Q24)
rubrics_metrics.description: Percent of the firm's 2022 IP billings allocated to types of IP work: patent applications & prosecution; trademark registration & prosecution; copyright registration applications; licensing; litigation (not including USPTO post‑grant actions); PTAB/TTAB proceedings; Privacy/Cybersecurity; Other IP work. Reported by firm size and by whether IP law is 75%+ of practice or less than 75%.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each type and subgroup, the table shows Number of Firms Reporting, Mean/Average, First Quartile (25%), Median, and Third Quartile (75%). Separate tables for IP≥75% and IP<75%.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total 2022 billings for professional legal services (Q25)
rubrics_metrics.description: Firm's total 2022 billings for professional legal services (dollar amounts), reported by number of attorneys, percent of practice that is IP, and location (various CMSAs/PMSAs/regions). Number of Firms Reporting and summary statistics (mean, first quartile, median, third quartile) provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Monetary values shown as Mean/Average and quartiles for each subgroup; Number of Firms Reporting included.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2022 billings per attorney (Q25)
rubrics_metrics.description: Billings per attorney for 2022 (dollar amounts), reported by firm-size, percent-of-practice that is IP, and location, with statistical summaries (first quartile, median, mean, Number of Firms Reporting).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Statistics include 25th percentile, median, and mean for each subgroup; used to normalize firm revenue by headcount.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statistical summary metrics used across tables
rubrics_metrics.description: Summary statistics reported repeatedly in tables: Mean (Average), First Quartile (25%), Median (Midpoint), Third Quartile (75%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These are the design/aggregation metrics used to present distributions for counts, percentages, and dollar amounts across all survey questions; some cells also show 'Number of Firms Reporting' or ISD (insufficient data).

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of Firms Reporting (per cell)
rubrics_metrics.description: For each metric/table cell the report shows the Number of Firms Reporting (sample size) used to compute the summary statistics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Essential metadata for interpreting means and quartiles; sometimes used to mark ISD where sample is insufficient.
